run_rl_algorithm: run the RL algorithm with parsed arguments and optional W&B tracking via main entry point
parse_all_args: parse command line arguments including custom env episode length and LLM reward coefficient
add_extra_params: add custom CLI arguments like episode length and LLM reward to an argparse parser
init_wandb_tracking: initialize Weights and Biases tracking for the nethack_project when WANDB_API_KEY is set
register_nle_components: import and register NetHack Learning Environment tasks, encoders, and environments for RL training
